professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained item-level demand forecasting models for 140 menu items across 62 restaurants using Python and LightGBM.
professionalSummary.witness: Built a LightGBM model at Brightwater Kitchens that forecasts next-day demand for 140 menu items in each of 62 restaurants, using holiday, weather and local-event features.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained feature pipelines in dbt with freshness and completeness tests for point-of-sale and delivery-app data.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the dbt project feeding the model and added freshness and not-null tests on the point-of-sale and delivery-app tables.

professionalSummary.text: Ran weekly forecast accuracy reviews with commissary planners, documenting forecast errors and manual overrides.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the Thursday forecast review with the commissary planners, going through items whose forecast error exceeded the agreed tolerance and logging every manual override.

professionalSummary.text: Documented model inputs, limitations, and retraining schedule in a model card presented to the data governance group in November 2023.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the model card (inputs, known weaknesses around new menu launches, monthly retraining schedule) and presented it to the data governance group in November 2023.

professionalSummary.text: Tracked and published weekly forecast accuracy metrics (weighted mean absolute percentage error) on a dashboard for planners.
professionalSummary.witness: Tracked weighted mean absolute percentage error on a rolling eight-week holdout and published it on the planners' dashboard each Monday.
